select
from SYS_BATCH_TASK t where SYSTEM_CODE = 'MODEL'
AND TASK_NAME = #{taskName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
and exists ( select 1 from SYS_BATCH_GRP t1, SYS_BATCH_JOB t2 where t1.seq_no = t2.batch_seq_no and t2.task_id = t.task_id and t1.seq_no = #{BATCH_GROUP_SEQNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
ORDER BY TASK_PRI, TASK_ID

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(LOGSINFO.SEQNO) totalNum, SUM(DECODE(LOGSINFO.EXEC_STATUS,'EXP',1,0)) errorNum, SUM(DECODE(LOGSINFO.EXEC_STATUS,'WARN',1,0)) warnNum, SUM(DECODE(LOGSINFO.EXEC_STATUS,'NOR',1,0)) successNum, EXEINFO.BATCH_EXEDETAIL_SEQ_NO as SEQ_NO, EXEINFO.EXECUTE_DATE, EXEINFO.CREATE_USER createUser, EXEINFO.CREATE_TIME createTime, EXEINFO.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, (extract(DAY FROM EXEINFO.update_time - EXEINFO.create_time) * 86400 + extract(hour FROM EXEINFO.update_time - EXEINFO.create_time) * 3600 + extract(minute FROM EXEINFO.update_time - EXEINFO.create_time) * 60 + extract(second FROM EXEINFO.update_time - EXEINFO.create_time)) * 1000 PROCESS_TIME, EXEINFO.TASK_STATUS status, TASK.TASK_NAME, EXEINFO.TASK_ID FROM SYS_BATCH_EXEC_INFO EXEINFO INNER JOIN SYS_BATCHGRP_EXEC_INFO GRPINFO ON EXEINFO.BATCH_EXEDETAIL_SEQ_NO = GRPINFO.SEQ_NO AND GRPINFO.BATCH_SEQ_NO = #{BATCH_GROUP_SEQNO, jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN SYS_BATCH_TASK TASK ON EXEINFO.TASK_ID = TASK.TASK_ID LEFT JOIN MOD_BATCH_LOGS LOGSINFO ON LOGSINFO.BATCH_EXEC_SEQNO = GRPINFO.SEQ_NO AND LOGSINFO.TASK_ID = EXEINFO.TASK_ID WHERE EXEINFO.EXECUTE_DATE = to_date(#{importDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY EXEINFO.BATCH_EXEDETAIL_SEQ_NO, EXEINFO.EXECUTE_DATE, EXEINFO.CREATE_USER, EXEINFO.CREATE_TIME, EXEINFO.UPDATE_TIME, EXEINFO.TASK_STATUS, TASK.TASK_NAME, EXEINFO.TASK_ID ORDER BY UPDATETIME DESC
